## Table 3. Model Calibration: 14-Day and 30-Day Horizons

```{r table3-calibration, echo=FALSE}
cal_tbl_data <- m1_cal_data %>%
  mutate(
    feature_label = recode(feature_mode, !!!feat_labels),
    algo          = str_to_title(model_type),
    horizon_label = paste0(horizon, "-day")
  )

if (nrow(cal_tbl_data) > 0) {
  cal_tbl_data %>%
    mutate(
      mean_predicted = round(mean_predicted, 3),
      observed_rate  = round(observed_rate,  3),
      n              = format(n,        big.mark = ","),
      n_events       = format(n_events, big.mark = ",")
    ) %>%
    arrange(horizon_label, feature_label, algo, prob_bin) %>%
    mutate(.grp = paste0(horizon_label, " - ", feature_label, " - ", algo)) %>%
    select(
      .grp,
      `Predicted prob. bin` = prob_bin,
      N                     = n,
      `Events (n)`          = n_events,
      `Mean predicted`      = mean_predicted,
      `Observed rate`       = observed_rate
    ) %>%
    gt(groupname_col = ".grp") %>%
    tab_header(title = "Table 3. Calibration table for 14-day and 30-day horizon models. Predicted probabilities are grouped into decile-based bins; observed event rates are compared to mean predicted probabilities within each bin. Well-calibrated models show observed rates close to mean predicted values.") %>%
    cols_align(align = "left",  columns = `Predicted prob. bin`) %>%
    cols_align(align = "right", columns = c(N, `Events (n)`, `Mean predicted`, `Observed rate`)) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.font.size       = px(11),
      table.width           = "auto",
      row_group.font.weight = "bold"
    )
} else {
  cat("*Calibration data not available - ensure models have been fit.*")
}

## Figure 4. ROC Curves at 30-Day Horizon

```{r fig3-roc, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4.5, fig.cap="Figure 4. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves for the 30-day composite outcome prediction. Left panel: logistic regression; right panel: XGBoost. Each panel shows three curves corresponding to the three feature sets. AUC values are annotated per curve. Dotted diagonal represents chance performance."}
roc_df <- m1_roc_data_30d %>%
  mutate(
    feature_label = recode(feature_mode, !!!feat_labels),
    algo          = dplyr::recode(model_type, xgboost = "XGBoost", logistic = "Logistic"),
    auc_label     = sprintf("AUC = %.3f", auc_val),
    sens          = tpr
  )

# AUC annotation positions (pick middle of each curve)
auc_annot <- roc_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature_label, algo) %>%
  dplyr::slice(round(dplyr::n() / 2)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

make_roc_panel <- function(algo_name) {
  d <- roc_df %>% filter(algo == algo_name)
  a <- auc_annot %>% filter(algo == algo_name)
  ggplot(d, aes(x = fpr, y = sens, color = feature_label, group = feature_label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted",
                linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey60") +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data = a %>% group_by(feature_label) %>% slice(1),
      aes(label = auc_label), size = 2.4, box.padding = 0.3,
      segment.size = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE,
      family = "Helvetica") +
    scale_color_manual(values = feat_colors, name = "Feature set") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = .02)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = .02)) +
    labs(title = algo_name, x = "1 – Specificity", y = "Sensitivity") +
    theme_science() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 7.5),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5),
          plot.title   = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"))
}

# ── AUC summary dot-and-whisker panel ────────────────────────────────────────────
if (exists("m1_summaries") && nrow(m1_summaries) > 0L) {
  p_auc_summary <- m1_summaries %>%
    mutate(
      feature_label = recode(feature_mode, !!!feat_labels),
      algo          = dplyr::recode(model_type, xgboost = "XGBoost", logistic = "Logistic"),
      horizon_label = paste0(horizon, "-day")
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = feature_label, y = auc,
               color = horizon_label, shape = algo,
               group = interaction(algo, horizon_label))) +
    geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(0.35)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = interaction(algo, horizon_label)),
              position = position_dodge(0.35), linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("14-day" = "#4575b4", "30-day" = "#d73027"),
                       name = "Horizon") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Logistic" = 16L, "XGBoost" = 17L),
                       name = "Algorithm") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1),
                       labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    labs(title = "AUC by Feature Set & Horizon",
         x = "Feature set", y = "AUC (ROC)") +
    theme_science() +
    theme(axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text    = element_text(size = 7.5),
          legend.title   = element_text(size = 7.5))
} else {
  p_auc_summary <- ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = "AUC summary unavailable")
}

# Install ggrepel if needed
if (!requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE))
  try(install.packages("ggrepel", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org", quiet = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
if (!requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) library(ggrepel)

p_roc <- tryCatch({
  library(ggrepel)
  make_roc_panel("Logistic") + make_roc_panel("XGBoost") + p_auc_summary +
    plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}, error = function(e) {
  # Fallback without ggrepel labels
  roc_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = fpr, y = sens, color = feature_label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=0,linetype="dotted",linewidth=0.3, color="grey60") +
    facet_wrap(~algo) +
    scale_color_manual(values = feat_colors, name = "Feature set") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy=1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy=1)) +
    labs(x = "1 – Specificity", y = "Sensitivity") +
    theme_science() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
})
ggsave(file.path(out_figures, "Figure_4_ROC_curves_30d.png"),
       plot = p_roc, width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
p_roc

  apply_feat_labels <- function(term_vec) {
    # Cleans recipe-encoded level suffixes: replaces dots with spaces (e.g.
    # "Black.or.African.American" -> "Black or African American") and converts
    # all-uppercase strings to title case (e.g. "MALE" -> "Male").
    clean_lv <- function(x) {
      x <- gsub(".", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
      dplyr::if_else(x == toupper(x), tools::toTitleCase(tolower(x)), x)
    }
    # All labels are pre-defined in feat_display_names; fall back to raw column name
    case_when(
      term_vec %in% names(feat_display_names) ~ feat_display_names[term_vec],
      TRUE ~ term_vec
    )
  }

  # Load pre-computed XGBoost importance (saved in target block)
  imp_combined <- m1_xgb_importance %>%
    filter(feature_mode == "model3_steps_and_static") %>%
    group_by(horizon) %>%
    arrange(desc(gain)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      horizon_label = if_else(horizon == 14L, "14-Day Horizon", "30-Day Horizon"),
      Category      = classify_feature(term),
      Gain          = round(gain, 5),
      Feature_label = apply_feat_labels(term),
      horizon_label = factor(horizon_label, levels = c("14-Day Horizon", "30-Day Horizon"))
    )

  # ── Save full XGBoost importance table (both horizons) to xlsx ────────────────
  xgb_all_imp <- m1_xgb_importance %>%
    mutate(Horizon = if_else(horizon == 14L, "14-Day", "30-Day")) %>%
    arrange(Horizon, desc(gain)) %>%
    mutate(
      Category      = classify_feature(term),
      Feature_label = apply_feat_labels(term)
    ) %>%
    select(Horizon, Feature_label, Feature_raw = term, Category,
           Gain = gain, Cover = cover, Frequency = frequency)
  writexl::write_xlsx(xgb_all_imp, file.path(out_data, "xgboost_feature_importance_14d_30d.xlsx"))

  # Per-facet y-axis ordering via tidytext
  if (!requireNamespace("tidytext", quietly = TRUE))
    try(install.packages("tidytext", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org", quiet = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
  if (requireNamespace("tidytext", quietly = TRUE)) {
    imp_combined <- imp_combined %>%
      mutate(Feature_ord = tidytext::reorder_within(Feature_label, Gain, horizon_label))
    y_scale_xgb <- tidytext::scale_y_reordered()
  } else {
    imp_combined <- imp_combined %>%
      mutate(Feature_ord = reorder(Feature_label, Gain))
    y_scale_xgb <- scale_y_discrete()
  }

  if (nrow(imp_combined) == 0) {
    cat("No XGBoost results available for Steps + Static.")
  } else {
    ggplot(imp_combined, aes(x = Gain, y = Feature_ord, fill = Category)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7) +
      geom_text(aes(label = round(Gain * 100, 2)), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.5) +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Feature category") +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
      y_scale_xgb +
      facet_wrap(~horizon_label, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(
        title = "",
        x     = "Gain (fraction of total information gain)",
        y     = NULL
      ) +
      theme_science() +
      theme(
        axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title    = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 9),
        strip.text      = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")
      ) -> p_xgb_imp
    ggsave(file.path(out_figures, "Figure_5_XGBoost_feature_importance.png"),
           plot = p_xgb_imp, width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    p_xgb_imp
  }

## Figure 6. Logistic Regression Coefficients: Steps + Static Model

```{r fig5-logistic-coefs, echo=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.cap="Figure 6. Top 20 elastic net–regularized logistic regression coefficients (OR scale, per 1 SD for continuous predictors): Steps + Static, 14-Day and 30-Day Horizons. Colored by feature category (Set2 palette). These are penalized estimates and should be interpreted as directional associations reflecting relative feature importance within the model, not formal hypothesis tests."}

# Load pre-computed logistic coefficients
m1_log_coefs <- arrow::read_parquet("data/output/m1_log_coefs.parquet")

coef_input <- m1_log_coefs %>%
  filter(feature_mode == "model3_steps_and_static",
         term != "(Intercept)", !is.na(odds_ratio))

if (nrow(coef_input) > 0) {

  coef_combined <- coef_input %>%
    group_by(horizon) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(statistic))) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      horizon_label = if_else(horizon == 14L, "14-Day Horizon", "30-Day Horizon"),
      Category      = classify_feature(term),
      Feature_label = apply_feat_labels(term),
      or_label      = sprintf("%.3f", odds_ratio),
      horizon_label = factor(horizon_label, levels = c("14-Day Horizon", "30-Day Horizon"))
    )

  # ── Save full logistic coefficient table (both horizons) to xlsx ──────────────
  log_all_coef <- m1_log_coefs %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      Horizon       = if_else(horizon == 14L, "14-Day", "30-Day"),
      Category      = classify_feature(term),
      Feature_label = apply_feat_labels(term)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Horizon, desc(abs(estimate))) %>%
    select(Horizon, Feature_label, Feature_raw = term, Category,
           Log_Odds = estimate, SE = std.error, Z = statistic,
           P_value = p.value, Odds_Ratio = odds_ratio)
  writexl::write_xlsx(log_all_coef, file.path(out_data, "logistic_coefficients_14d_30d.xlsx"))

  # Per-facet y-axis ordering
  if (requireNamespace("tidytext", quietly = TRUE)) {
    coef_combined <- coef_combined %>%
      mutate(Feature_ord = tidytext::reorder_within(Feature_label, abs(estimate), horizon_label))
    y_scale_log <- tidytext::scale_y_reordered()
  } else {
    coef_combined <- coef_combined %>%
      mutate(Feature_ord = reorder(Feature_label, abs(estimate)))
    y_scale_log <- scale_y_discrete()
  }

  if (nrow(coef_combined) == 0) {
    cat("No logistic results available for Steps + Static.")
  } else {
    ggplot(coef_combined,
           aes(x = odds_ratio, y = Feature_ord, color = Category)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_text(aes(label = or_label), hjust = -0.25, size = 2.5, color = "black") +
      scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Feature category") +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.75, 1.75), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))) +
      y_scale_log +
      facet_wrap(~horizon_label, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(
        title = "",
        x     = "Regularized coefficient (OR scale, per 1 SD for continuous predictors)",
        y     = NULL
      ) +
      theme_science() +
      theme(
        axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title    = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 9),
        strip.text      = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")
      ) -> p_log_coef
    ggsave(file.path(out_figures, "Figure_6_Logistic_OR_coefficients.png"),
           plot = p_log_coef, width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    p_log_coef
  }
} # end if (nrow(coef_input) > 0)
```

*Note: Coefficients are elastic net–penalized estimates (glmnet, Steps + Static model). Penalization shrinks estimates toward zero and the plot carries no inferential standard errors or significance thresholds; values reflect the direction and relative magnitude of each feature's contribution within the regularized model. A full coefficient table is saved to `logistic_coefficients_14d_30d.xlsx`.*
